senses.gloss: f. (חרר III) soot, sediment of ink, shoe-black.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:7">Nidd. II, 7</cite> <he>כח׳</he>; <cite ref="Niddah 19a">ib. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>כחָרוּת</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 3:11">Tosef. ib. III, 11</cite> (not <he>בה׳</he>); expl.
<cite ref="Niddah 20a:17">Nidd. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>כי חרותא דדיותא</he>, v. <cite ref="D00545"><he>דְּיוּתָא</he></cite>.—Y. Sot. VII, 22ᵈ <he>חָרוּתָהּ אש וכ׳</he> its ink was black fire.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:1:9">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ</cite> top <he>פשתן שצבעו בח׳</he> (ed. <he>בחרם</he>, corr. acc.) linen dyed with blacking (looking like wool).
